Maria (Docs): Hey team — opened a docs PR for the Optimize toolkit (batching / caching / quant profiles). Need short reviews + confirmation on the SDK snippets and migration wording. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/742

Sam (ML): @Maria looking. For quant profiles I'd recommend showing 'fp16' vs 'q4_0' with a brief cost/quality note. Quick example:
```
# quant profile example
quant_profile:
  name: q4_0
  target: latency
  expected_speedup: "~2x"
  notes: "good for short chats; check on long-context eval"
```
I'll run the eval set after updates.

Alex (DevEx): I can update SDK snippets (Python + TS). Which API did we change? If it's `client.batch_config` -> `client.optimize.batch` I'll add a migration note and small code examples:
```
# python
from redwood import Client
c = Client()
# old
# c.batch_config(...)
# new
c.optimize.batch(...)
```

Jeff (Product): small wording ask — instead of 'use quantization aggressively' let's say 'consider quantization for cost-sensitive workloads' so we don't imply a one-size-fits-all. Also add a short callout about expected accuracy delta.

CI Bot: Build failed: link-checker detected dead link to INTERNAL_DOCS/old-optimize.md. failing step: docs/link-checker. CI log: https://ci.redwood-inference.com/builds/9843/log

Maria (Docs): Thanks — @Alex can you fix the JS/TS snippets and replace that dead link with /optimize/migration? I'll re-run the docs build after your patch. Also please add a short 'migration v1->v2' checklist (config keys changed) so customers can update easily.

Sam (ML): Also add a note to run the quality regression harness after switching quant profiles: `python tools/eval_quality.py --profile q4_0 --dataset small_seed`

Alex (DevEx): Assigned the PR to myself, pushing a patch in ~30m. Replaced dead link + added Python/TS examples and the migration checklist. Will ping when CI is green. :thumbsup:

CI Bot: CI re-run queued by Maria (Docs) — build #9844 queued.
